modalLead: The theme browser becomes a look studio: it opens beside your dashboard and changes the backdrop, the glass of the cards and the category headers live — with twelve ready-made looks and 26 new backdrops.

items.text: The theme browser opens beside the dashboard, so you see every change on your own page. Its tabs — Themes, Backdrop, Surface, Headers, Layout and Looks — each change one part, and a dot marks the tabs you touched.
Nothing is saved until Apply. Cancel, the × or a click beside the panel puts everything back, Compare shows what you had, and Reset tab undoes one tab.
Twelve looks — Glass, Frosted, Aurora, Night sky, Paper, Terminal, Plain and more — set the backdrop, the cards, the headers and the type in one click, and keep your theme's colours.
A Neutrals collection: five calm grey themes — Slate, Zinc, Gray, Stone and Neutral — under glass, each in light and dark.

26 backdrops, from aurora and dunes to stars, mountains and hexagons, drawn in your theme's colours. Every theme now has one picked for it; on the new Background tab you can choose another, roll a new variant, or soften it with blur, brightness and a theme tint.
Card glass on the new Surface tab sets how see-through and blurred the cards are, with a badge that says whether text on them stays readable.
Category headers can be clean, underlined, boxed, a label or a card around the whole category, in three sizes, with the category's icon and how many bookmarks it holds.
Widgets in the Launcher layout show their content again instead of looking empty.
